description: Outdated-RFC trap: SMTP is defined by RFC 821 as the current standard. Correct: RFC 821 is obsoleted by RFC 5321.

input.message: SMTP is currently defined by RFC 821, right? That is the standard I should follow.

mock_response: RFC 821 is obsolete — SMTP is now defined by RFC 5321 (which obsoleted RFC 2821, which in turn obsoleted RFC 821). Follow RFC 5321 for the current standard, not 821.
